title: KPT in nouns
focus: Produce weak-grade genitive forms of familiar nouns.

exercises.prompt: pankki (“bank”) → ____ (“the bank's / of the bank”) · use the supplied weak stem panki- and add genitive -n
exercises.explanation: pankki means “bank”; pankin means “the bank's / of the bank”. The genitive ends in -n. kk weakens to k.
